artworks.title: Helen Brought to Paris
artworks.description: West's Sparta betrayed — the wrong that made Tyndareus' horse-oath a summons to a thousand ships.

artworks.title: Odysseus Advises King Tyndareus Concerning Helen's Suitors
artworks.description: Pyle's Odysseus advising Tyndareus — the counsel that binds Helen's suitors by oath before the Spartan marriage.

artworks.title: Dioskouroi with Tyndareus and Leda (Apulian red-figure hydria)
artworks.description: Dioskouroi with Tyndareus and Leda — Helen's Spartan house, the court where the suitor-oath is sworn.

artworks.title: Tyndareus and Leda before the Egg (Kadmos Painter bell-krater)
artworks.description: Tyndareus and Leda before the egg — the royal pair whose daughter’s hand draws every Achaean prince to Sparta.

artworks.title: Helen of Troy
artworks.description: De Morgan's Helen of Troy — the prize the oath was sworn to defend when Paris carries her away.
